page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: running head at top, one paragraph of italic text, a woodcut ornament below it, and the catchword at the lower right. Right page: only its left edge is visible, with a running head fragment, a large initial and a few partial letters down the margin. No margin notes on the left page.

p.i: Optârim autem, doctos viros aliquid limatiùs de hoc ipso præcognito in medium afferre. Ego feci quod potui; potui, quantum Dominus hoc tempore dedit: quem rogo ex intimo cordis affectu, ut studiis nostris benedicat, ad nominis sui sacrosancti gloriam, & commune bonum, Amen.

page.notes: The left page carries a woodcut ornament below the paragraph: a framed cartouche with two figures, a bird-like creature and a vase or altar with flames, flanked by scrolled supports. It has no text. The right page is cut off at the scan edge. Only fragments are visible: a running head beginning with "D", an ornamental mark, a large initial "T", and partial letters "P", "Q", "b", "t" and "c" at the margin. These cannot be read as words and are not transcribed. Long s is written as plain s throughout the left page. Printed words were copied as seen; none are marked uncertain.
